Hi! I write about **philosophy**, **neuroscience**, **disability**, **AI**.

Academic --- I'm interested in **Neurophilosophy**\*; my degree is in **Economics**.  
[\* - e.g., Dopamine being a prerequisite for *Action*.]{.small-text}

I lost 70-80 dB of my hearing when I was 10; sheared my brainstem when I was 24. Yikes!

A lot here is about **neurorehabilitation** ([articles](/articles/) particularly).  
Very relevant for: Long Covid, mild Traumatic Brain Injury / Concussion, Neurodegenerative Diseases, ABIs, Diffuse Axonal Injury.  
SCIs, Strokes, Tumors - less confidence.
